cases.purpose: Compare info read-ahead in sectors at two non-default settings, UUID formatting, and name/UUID and suspended/inactive state queries.
cases.comparison: Compare captured status, stdout and stderr byte-for-byte; setup and teardown failures fail the case. Use a disposable isolated guest and settle udev before querying.
cases.script:
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
D() { /usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync "$@"; }
cleanup() { D remove --noudevsync rq-read-ahead >/dev/null 2>&1; }
trap cleanup EXIT
D create rq-read-ahead -u RQ-READ-AHEAD --table '0 64 zero' || exit 1
/usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 || exit 1
node=/dev/mapper/rq-read-ahead
[[ -b $node ]] || exit 1
query() { "$@"; s=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$s"; }
for n in 32 512; do
  /usr/sbin/blockdev --setra "$n" "$node" || exit 1
  printf 'read-ahead=%s\n' "$n"
  query dmsetup info rq-read-ahead
  query dmsetup info -u RQ-READ-AHEAD
done
D suspend rq-read-ahead || exit 1
query dmsetup info rq-read-ahead
D resume rq-read-ahead || exit 1
D load rq-read-ahead --table '0 64 error' || exit 1
query dmsetup info rq-read-ahead
D clear rq-read-ahead || exit 1
D remove rq-read-ahead || exit 1
trap - EXIT
